issues.title: Ingest the Palm Beach County budget
issues.learned: FY2026 all-funds budget $9,606,627,411 — but ~21% is held Reserves and ~$968M is interfund transfers, so the real operating appropriation is ~$4.58B. The Sheriff’s Office ($1.10B) is the largest agency. Foots to the county’s own Budget in Brief.

issues.title: Pull the exact General Fund figure
issues.detail: The Budget in Brief reports all-funds and a tax-equivalent operating view but not a single General Fund line; the full Annual Budget Book fund-summary page has it.
